description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a task form page, facilitating creation and editing of tasks, including fields for title, description, priority, status, project assignment, due date/time, and tags. It also includes logic for saving and deleting tasks through repositories.

classes.name: TaskFormPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that presents a form for creating or editing a task, handling user input, validation, and interactions with task repository.

classes.name: _TaskFormPageState
classes.description: State class managing the form state, initializing data from an existing task if editing, handling user actions like save and delete, and UI rendering.

classes.name: _PriorityPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting task priority via a dropdown menu.

classes.name: _StatusPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting task status via a dropdown menu.

classes.name: _ProjectPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting an associated project from streamed project list.

classes.name: _TagsPicker
classes.description: A widget for selecting multiple tags, displayed as filter chips, with state management of selected tags.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the form with existing task data if provided.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _pickDueDateTime
methods.description: Prompts user to pick a due date and time.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Validates form and stores the task via the repository, handling UI state and navigation.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes the task if editing an existing task.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the task form page.
